environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application deployed in a Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The auth-service pod runs in the 'auth' namespace with strict mTLS (PeerAuthentication STRICT mode). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy is applied to the auth-service workload that evaluates source namespace and request attributes. The policy specifies: (1) requests with header 'X-Internal-Service' matching any value are ONLY permitted when source.namespace is in ['session-mgmt', 'sso-infra'] — external traffic entering via istio-ingressgateway has source.namespace='istio-system' and the gateway's VirtualService strips X-Internal-Service headers via a HeaderOperations removeRequestHeaders rule before routing to the auth namespace. (2) The AuthorizationPolicy uses a DENY action for requests carrying X-Internal-Service header where source.principal does not match 'cluster.local/ns/session-mgmt/sa/session-manager-sa' or 'cluster.local/ns/sso-infra/sa/sso-gateway-sa'. The envoy sidecar enforces this at L7 before the request reaches the application container.
